module_summary: UART-style serial transmitter: a 4-state FSM (idle/start/data/stop) loads a byte into a shift register and shifts it out LSB-first, paced by a baud-tick counter and a 3-bit bit counter.

anchors.name: n12_921
anchors.why: Four-state idle/start/data/stop controller sequencing the frame and selecting the serial line value.

anchors.name: n7_392
anchors.why: 8-bit shift register loaded with the input byte, shifted right once per bit period.

anchors.name: n18_997
anchors.why: Serial output line: low start bit, shift-register LSB during data, high when idle/stop.

anchors.name: n6_cbb
anchors.why: Parallel byte to transmit, captured into the shift register on start.

anchors.name: n17_093
anchors.why: Start request; in idle it loads the byte and launches the frame.

anchors.name: n19_d4d
anchors.why: Ready output, high while FSM is idle and can accept a new byte.

anchors.name: n13_97d
anchors.why: Baud divider counter, cleared in idle and at each bit period end.

anchors.name: n3_3f2
anchors.why: Bit-period tick when baud counter wraps; advances FSM, shifts data, bumps bit counter.

anchors.name: n1_cb7
anchors.why: Counts transmitted data bits; reaching 7 ends the data state.

anchors.name: n16_235
anchors.why: Busy indication, high whenever FSM is not idle.

groups.name: tx_controller
groups.description: Frame FSM with next-state logic and ready/busy decode.

groups.name: baud_timer
groups.description: Divider counter generating the per-bit tick.

groups.name: tx_shifter
groups.description: Shift register and bit counter producing the serial output.
